scenes.title: Une chance pour Samy  (A Chance for Samy)
scenes.summary: At a café, Gérard Lanvin urges Mathias to offer a screen test to their eager young waiter Samy for a small bodyguard role in his upcoming film.

scenes.title: Projet d'agence secrète  (Secret Agency Project)
scenes.summary: Andréa and Gabriel meet secretly with their lawyer to prepare a rival agency, while back at ASK, Camille accidentally submits Samy for a major leading role.

scenes.title: La visite de Catherine  (Catherine's Visit)
scenes.summary: Catherine Barneville visits an injured Noémie at her apartment with a thoughtful gift, and the two bond over meditation, yoga, and shamanism books.

scenes.title: Un si beau couple  (Such a Beautiful Couple)
scenes.summary: At a tea room, Catherine Barneville confides in Camille about her marriage with Mathias and their couples therapy.

scenes.title: L'agence NOW  (Agency NOW)
scenes.summary: At ASK, Hicham pitches rebranding the agency to NOW, but Mathias argues strongly against erasing Samuel Kerr's legacy.

scenes.title: Cent vingt copies  (One Hundred and Twenty Copies)
scenes.summary: In Mathias's office, Sophia Leprince panics over the limited theatrical release of Julien Doré's film and threatens to quit acting.

scenes.title: Erreur de casting  (Casting Mistake)
scenes.summary: Gabriel discovers he mixed up the names Bassem and Baptiste for a major role opposite Gérard Lanvin, leaving an urgent voicemail for Mathias.

scenes.title: L'engagement de Camille  (Camille's Commitment)
scenes.summary: Camille Valentini and her boyfriend Camille celebrate their romantic commitment, and she urges him to rush to the casting studio.

scenes.title: L'audition imprévue  (The Unexpected Audition)
scenes.summary: At the casting studio, an inexperienced actor auditions claiming natural charisma, while the casting team takes his costume measurements.

scenes.title: L'essayage de costumes  (The Costume Fitting)
scenes.summary: During a costume fitting, Gérard Lanvin gets measured while Mathias panics over the phone that an inexperienced newcomer was put forward for a major film role.

scenes.title: Le nouveau talent brut  (The Raw New Talent)
scenes.summary: The casting team praises the explosive audition of young actor Samy, and junior agent Camille Valentini proudly steps forward as his official representative.

scenes.title: La future star du cinéma  (The Future Cinema Star)
scenes.summary: Mathias furiously confronts Camille for bypassing agency protocol, but Camille triumphantly reveals that her discovery Samy dazzled the directors and won a callback.

scenes.title: L'agent double  (The Double Agent)
scenes.summary: Camille and Hervé set up a shared secret identity as "Camille Valentini" with matching phones and a shared inbox, until Annick calls on speakerphone.

scenes.title: Les essais de Samy  (Samy's Screen Test)
scenes.summary: At the studio costume room, eager newcomer Samy meets star Gérard Lanvin before his screen test, while director Emma looks for chemistry between them.

scenes.title: Donner la réplique  (Running Lines)
scenes.summary: Camille reassures Gérard Lanvin about his lead role in the film, and Gérard generously agrees to run lines with enthusiastic newcomer Samy.

scenes.title: Le casting de Samy  (Samy's Casting)
scenes.summary: During an audition with Gérard Lanvin, young actor Samy panics and fails his screen test. While Camille passionately defends his talent, Mathias insists that they must cut their losses to protect the film, forcing Camille to leave a painful voicemail.

scenes.title: Croiser Guy Marchand  (Crossing Paths with Guy Marchand)
scenes.summary: Andréa encounters veteran client Guy Marchand at the agency, who mentions seeing her on Avenue de Trudaine where her secret meetings take place. Andréa covers up quickly by claiming she was apartment-hunting with Colette, then teases Guy about his reliance on tarot fortune-telling.

scenes.title: L'échec de Julien Doré  (Julien Doré's Flop)
scenes.summary: At a bar, Julien Doré learns his auteur film bombed at the box office. When Sofia reveals that Gabriel deliberately sabotaged the France 2 funding, Julien initially reacts with fury before realizing the sabotage granted him total artistic freedom to create a masterpiece.

scenes.title: J'ai la haine  (I'm So Angry)
scenes.summary: Outside on the street, young waiter Samy catches up with Gérard Lanvin, confessing his bitter regret and apologizing for blowing the audition after Gérard gave him his break.

scenes.title: Envoyer à la casse  (Sent to the Scrap Heap)
scenes.summary: Sitting on the curb, Gérard Lanvin confesses to Samy that he sabotaged their scene out of fear of being outshone by Samy youth and raw talent.

scenes.title: Soixante-dix films  (Seventy Films)
scenes.summary: Reconciling on the street, Gérard Lanvin and Samy joke about their age gap and aches before Gérard commits to calling the director back to support Samy.

scenes.title: Les premières contractions  (The First Contractions)
scenes.summary: À l'agence ASK, Camille discute de la facturation des contrats avec Mathias, avant qu'Andréa ne l'appelle en urgence dans son bureau pour de violentes douleurs au ventre.

scenes.title: Des soupçons et des douleurs  (Suspicions and Pains)
scenes.summary: Arlette vient parler de maternité et de Samuel Kerr dans le bureau d'Andréa, tout en découvrant les visites secrètes de locaux d'Andréa et Gabriel, au moment où les contractions d'Andréa s'intensifient.

scenes.title: L'accouchement à l'agence  (Delivery at the Agency)
scenes.summary: Dans le bureau d'Andréa, un accouchement d'urgence s'improvise : guidés par une sage-femme au téléphone, Arlette et Mathias aident Andréa à mettre son bébé au monde.

scenes.title: Une nouvelle vie à l'agence  (A New Life at the Agency)
scenes.summary: Après la naissance du bébé, Andréa se repose tandis que Mathias reste tard dans la nuit pour nettoyer le sol du bureau, rejoint par sa fille Camille.
